description: Machine-readable inventory of the authoritative correction-data CSVs under src/guiskindose/table_data/. The CSVs are the source of truth, read at runtime through the correction_data.py provider (explicit legacy SQLite databases validate read-only via check_explicit_db). Fields with value unknown are explicitly undocumented provenance, not oversights.

tables.runtime_consumer: geom_calc.fetch_and_append_hvl (SELECT * FROM hvl_combined; anode-angle slice select, then clamped bilinear interpolation on the (kVp, Cu) plane per dev-docs/plans/archive/hvl-interpolation-and-below-floor-kvp.md)

columns.name: anode_angle_deg
columns.note: Discrete tube-target property: slice-selected (11 deg where present, else 8), never interpolated.

tables.upstream_history: Inherited from the upstream 2018 initial commit; regenerated per dev-docs/plans/archive/hvl-interpolation-and-below-floor-kvp.md

tables.generation_method: SpekCalc 11-deg anode slice input to hvl_combined.csv (see build_hvl_table.py); NOT consulted at runtime
SpekCalc 8-deg anode slice input to hvl_combined.csv (see build_hvl_table.py); NOT consulted at runtime

tables.runtime_consumer: corrections.calculate_k_med (4-column projection kvp_kv/hvl_mmal/field_side_length_cm/mu_en_quotient; nearest tabulated field size, then kVp, then HVL)

columns.name: h
columns.note: No runtime consumer; retained for provenance.

columns.name: backscatter
columns.note: No runtime consumer (k_bs uses hard-coded polynomial coefficients in corrections.py); retained for provenance.

tables.literature: doi:10.1088/0031-9155/58/2/247 (Benmakhlouf et al., backscatter factors and mass energy-absorption coefficient ratios for surface dose determination in diagnostic radiology)
